nodes.title: Prompt + RefCap
Read me
widgets_values:
## 2. Generate with a RefCap (Replay, exact)
**H3 RefCap Replay** gives the model exactly what *MiniMax H3 Reference to Video* would with the original photos. It runs the text encoder over the captured photos together with your prompt, and attaches the captured latents. In the tests its clips were **pixel-identical** to native references.

**Wiring**
- The latent comes from *Empty MiniMax H3 AV Latent*; Replay doesn't make one.
- Pick the file in the `refcap` dropdown (files in `models/refcaps/`; refresh the browser after capturing one).
- The text encoder still reads the photos every run, as with native references. What you skip is loading, resizing and VAE-encoding them.

**Measured** (ArcFace face similarity to the photos; 2 London Set subjects x 2 scenes x 3 seeds, 608x352, 56 frames, on a community H3 turbo finetune at 8 steps):

| path | vs native references (`match`) | recognisable as the person |
|---|---|---|
| native reference node | baseline (0.62-0.71) | 12/12 |
| **H3 RefCap Replay** | identical, pixel for pixel | 12/12 |
| Replay, RefCap captured from 1024 px photos with `max` | **+0.06**, higher in 12/12; ~2.2x render time, 163 MB file | 12/12 |
| H3 RefCap Apply (cached) | -0.01 | 12/12 |
| Apply, latents only / rows only | -0.08 / -0.27 | 12/12 |
| RefMod Full Reference (ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod, 1024 px) | +0.03 Apply, +0.05 Text Encode; the 1024 px RefCap beat its best path in 11/12 | 12/12 |
| RefMod Compressed Reference | -0.60 to -0.62 | 0/12 |
| no references | -0.66 | 0/12 |

**More identity:** capture from ~1024 px photos with `ref_image_size` = `max`, if you can afford the render time. Details: `REFCAP_README.md` in ComfyUI-RefCap.

**Settings in these workflows** follow ComfyUI's MiniMax H3 reference-to-video template: the ref2va model with its 4-step Lightning LoRA, 4 steps, `res_multistep` + `simple`, 608x352. For the base model, bypass the *Lightning LoRA* node and use 20 steps. The measurements quoted here ran on a community H3 turbo finetune (shift 6/3, 8 steps) on a 12 GB GPU. Raise the size and length for final renders; the reference tokens ride through every step, so more photos and larger captures cost time.

nodes.title: Prompt guide
widgets_values:
## Writing the prompt
H3's reference mode reads a structured prompt. The photos are labelled in order: `<Picture 1>` ... `<Picture N>`, where N is the number of photos in the RefCap.

```
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>, a white woman in her mid-twenties with dark brown, wavy, shoulder-length hair.

summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> sits at a sunlit cafe table and smiles at the camera.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the woman's facial identity and hairstyle are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic, full-color cinematic shot with warm daylight.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up shows <Subject 1>, wearing a navy t-shirt, ...

overall_soundscape:
Gentle street ambience.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
```

**Tips**
- Describe age, gender and hair, and **say the outfit and action you want**. The photos supply the face; the prompt supplies everything else.
- Don't count on a name. The tests never used one.
- More detail in `detailed_description` (camera, lighting, motion, sound) gives better shots. MiniMax's guide suggests 350-500 words for final renders.
- Official format guide: MiniMax-H3 `docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md`.
